gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-readex-pro: Commanding up top, Wallpoet curves smoothly and lets paper show between its letters. Readex Pro is the quieter worker, keeping one steady weight from word to word with broad gaps at its terminals.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-ruda: Wallpoet is loud, smooth-curved and gapped between its letters. Ruda feels friendlier beside it, drawn like one pen tip with wide-mouthed rounds, moving the page from commanding to approachable.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-sofia-sans-semi-cond: Distinctive from the first glance, Unica One gives lowercase a huge eye and daylight inside every curve. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed shares that openness, with big entrances into its curves and a constant weight.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-savate: Goldman sets wide, generously spaced letters with round forms like open parentheses. Savate brings the surprise, sturdy hairlines that shift subtly in weight along each curve, with open jaws on every round stroke.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Bold, with paper showing between the letters, Wallpoet leads with smooth curves and a high lowercase. Schibsted Grotesk supplies open e and a bowls and terminals that never close in, giving the shouting above somewhere friendly to land.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-radio-canada-bi: Expressive and spaghetti-like, Funnel Display keeps every stroke one width and its c tips well apart. But Radio Canada Big does the steadier work, its x-height filling the line and its terminals held back from the stem.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Noto Sans Sharada sits below Flavors, whose pencil-stroke x-height towers and whose diagonals match its stems. Noto Sans Sharada gives paragraphs a clean, bulky texture, its open c forms keeping the text from clotting into rings.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Letters set like tiles with wide grout lines, Audiowide runs smooth curves with no swelling or thinning, very futuristic. Noto Sans Elbasan feels softer beside it, open at every terminal.
gen-almendra-display-fs-nunito: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display never lets its letters pinch shut and carries a pronounced x-height. Nunito brings big round lowercase bowls and terminals that stop short of the stem, so paragraphs go down easily.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-sono: Sono spaces its letters generously and leaves each a open at the mouth. Beside Gugi, whose terminals are cut open and bold, the loose spacing lets a paragraph unroll slowly and without friction.
